run_migrate_checkpoint_cli: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI to convert an ocp_dev checkpoint to fm_release format with output path
run_migrate_checkpoint_add_stress: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI with --add-stress flag to add stress tasks for datasets missing them
run_migrate_checkpoint_rm_static: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI with --no-remove-static-keys to preserve static keys in the state dictionary
test_migrate_checkpoint_function: test the migrate_checkpoint function by loading a checkpoint and verifying config updates and key removals
review_renameunpickler_class: review the RenameUnpickler class that overrides find_class to remap old module names using the import mapping
